generated.what_happened: Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers shot a 28-year-old undocumented Dominican national, Oscar Belgal, during an attempted arrest on Thursday afternoon in Marble Hill. A five-year-old child was inside the vehicle at the time of the gunfire but was physically unhurt, while Belgal suffered a neck wound and was taken to a local hospital before being moved to federal detention. Following the shooting, demonstrators gathered outside the hospital and engaged in confrontations with local police officers. In response to the confrontation, New York Governor Kathy Hochul and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani spoke with federal officials, including President Donald Trump, to request a halt to federal immigration enforcement operations in New York.
